basics.name: Alex Morgan
basics.label: Senior Full Stack Developer & Cloud Architect
basics.summary: Senior Full Stack Developer and Cloud Architect with over 10 years of experience designing and building scalable, high-performance web applications and distributed systems. Passionate about clean code, developer experience, and open-source innovation. Proven track record leading cross-functional teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions across fintech, e-commerce, and SaaS industries.

work.name: CloudNova Systems
work.position: Senior Full Stack Developer & Tech Lead
work.summary: Leading a team of 8 developers building a cloud-native SaaS platform for enterprise resource management serving over 50,000 daily active users.
highlights: Architected and implemented a microservices-based platform reducing infrastructure costs by 40%
Led migration from monolithic architecture to event-driven microservices using Kafka and RabbitMQ
Established CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time from 2 hours to 12 minutes
Mentored 5 junior developers through structured code review and pair programming sessions
Implemented real-time data synchronization using WebSockets and Redis Pub/Sub

work.name: BrightPixel Studio

highlights: Built a custom e-commerce platform handling 10,000+ daily transactions with 99.9% uptime
Designed RESTful and GraphQL APIs serving mobile and web clients
Reduced page load times by 60% through code splitting, lazy loading, and CDN optimization
Implemented OAuth2 authentication flows and role-based access control systems
Collaborated with UX designers to improve conversion rates by 35% through A/B testing

work.name: DataWave Analytics
work.summary: Specialized in building interactive data visualization dashboards and real-time analytics interfaces for fintech clients.
